_doc: The Ashen (ADR-0048): living tribespeople of the high timber, painted in lichen-ash. Enemies with archetype `tribe` and a `behavior.tribe` block: role `raider` (closes to melee with an axe or club) or `scout` (watches from cover first, throws spears). No infection, no Bloom; they bleed. AshenDirector spawns them (camps, scouts, raids) and gives them their band; `gamestage_min` is checked there, not by the wanderer tables (biomes never list them).

defs.name: Ashen Raider
defs.description: A tribesman of the high timber, ash-grey from scalp to heel, with a stone axe. They kill outsiders who might carry the Bloom.

defs.name: Ashen Scout
defs.description: Lean and quiet, painted in bands. Watches from the treeline before the others come, and throws a spear hard enough to pin a man.
